newsitem.title: UK: Labour to take action against MP - BBC.
newsitem.headline: Labour to take action against MP - BBC.

text.p: The Labour Party is take tough disciplinary action against Mohammed Sarwar, Britain's first Moslem member of parliament, who has been accused of trying to bribe an election opponent, the BBC said on Thursday.
Sarwar, who won the Glasgow Govan seat in the May 1 election that brought Labour to power, says the 5,000 pounds he gave to a rival candidate was a loan and not a bribe.

The BBC said the MP would "have the whip withdrawn for a period" -- which amounts to a temporary expulsion from the parliamentary Labour Party -- pending the outcome of a police investigation into the bribery allegations.
But the party would stop short of the ultimate sanction of permananent expulsion.
Sarwar will learn his fate later on Thursday when he attends a meeting with the team set up by Labour's National Executive Committee to look into the case.
Labour was also expected to take action against the local party branch in Govan, the BBC said.
